optimizedDescription.value: GetStatus reconciles active changes then projects artifacts, checks, blockers, validity, tracking and next action; drafts stay read-only.

optimizedContext.value:
# GetStatus

## Rules
- Input `name`; optional `refreshImplementationTracking` (default true, active only); optional `ifModifiedSince`.
- Resolve `ChangeRepository.get` then `getDraft`; neither -> `ChangeNotFoundError` (`CHANGE_NOT_FOUND`). Never `getDiscarded` (use `GetDiscarded`).
- Draft: `draftView`, no `change`; read-only; `projectArtifacts` only (no `evaluateLifecycle`/`evaluateLifecycleVerdict`); `availableTransitions`/`availableSteps` empty; `nextArtifact` null; `nextAction.command` no transition/validate. Satisfies `core:drafted-change-view`. Never refreshes.
- Active: resolve schema via `ResolveChangeSchema` (no mutation) -> `RefreshImplementationTracking.execute({ name })` unless false -> single reconciler (atomic commit, no duplicate events/returns) -> respond from committed change. Never call `ImplementationDetector` directly.
- Schema failure: read-only, no refresh/reconcile, blocker `SCHEMA_RESOLUTION_FAILED`; `SchemaProviderIdentityMismatchError` -> `SCHEMA_IDENTITY_MISMATCH` with `details.requestedName`/`returnedName`. No throw. `lifecycle` present: `validTransitions`/`availableTransitions`/`lifecycle.blockers` empty, `nextArtifact` null, `schemaInfo` null, `approvals`/`changePath` populated. Same for drafts. After schema success, check/reconcile failures propagate. `ResolveChangeSchema` advisories exposed as structured warnings.
- `ifModifiedSince`: only after refresh+reconcile; parsed ts >= reconciled `change.updatedAt` -> `unchanged: true`, `artifactStatuses` [], `blockers` [], minimal review (`required: false`) and nextAction; still returns reconciled change + `specDependsOn`. Invalid/older -> full path. Drafts may use own optimization.
- Result: `change` xor `draftView`, `artifactStatuses`, `specDependsOn`, `review`, `blockers`, `nextAction`, tracked impl files w/ review state, confirmed impl links (file + symbol-level), `ValidityStatusProjection` (not raw `ChangeValidityVerdict`).
- `artifactStatuses`: exactly one per `schema.artifacts()` type; unattached -> `missing`. `effectiveStatus` via `evaluateLifecycle`/`projectArtifacts` (recursive dep blocking). Canonical state kept in `state`/`effectiveStatus`.
- Display: file `hasDrift`, `displayStatus` (`complete-with-drift` only if `complete` && `hasDrift`); entry `displayStatus` aggregated from files, real workflow states outrank drift.
- `taskCompletion` `{complete, incomplete, total}` optional per task-capable artifact (`hasTasks`, `taskCompletionCheck`); from `workflow.taskCompletion` check/`CountTasks.byArtifact`; omit if file missing/empty; never second `CountTasks`; memoize per evaluation pass, no instance cache. No global snapshot bag; no `evaluateLifecycle`-then-CountTasks.
- Candidates: for each protocol-legal target use shared evaluator with `TransitionChange`: `listBypassedWorkflowSteps(from, to, schema, approvals)`, normal predicates (`resolveEffectiveBindings`), plus each `scope: 'step-skip'` set for optional bypassed steps. Collect every matching predicate (no fail-fast). Failed step-skip removes shortcut; empty set passes. `availableTransitions`, `checksByTarget`, blockers, `nextAction` projected only from complete results. Projection-only: no effects/hooks/persistence; `TransitionChange` recalcs on fresh state. Expose check rows (id, kind, outcome, code/message on fail); `effect` rows not required.
- `state === 'archivable'`: also run archive predicates (`resolveEffectiveBindings` op `archive`, schema `archiveChecks`, no `hook.pre`/`hook.post`, `skipChecks` empty). Schema-disabled check -> no blocker. Live `spec.overlap` fail -> `OVERLAP_CONFLICT`; `bypassFlag: '--skip-checks spec.overlap'` only if archive binding skippable. With it: `nextAction.command` `/specd-archive`, `targetStep` `archivable`, reason names live overlap (+bypass if skippable), not `Ready to archive`; `availableTransitions` MAY still list `archiving`. `review.reason === 'spec-overlap-conflict'` never adds `OVERLAP_CONFLICT`.
- `nextAction.command` from `evaluateLifecycle` (app guidance), never domain `nextHop`. Domain projection I/O-free.
- Blockers: `ARTIFACT_DRIFT` (reason `artifact-drift`), `REVIEW_REQUIRED` (`artifact-review-required`), `INCOMPLETE_ARTIFACT` per required artifact `missing`/`in-progress` (no `MISSING_ARTIFACT`), failed-predicate codes (`APPROVAL_REQUIRED`, `INCOMPLETE_TASKS`, `DEPS_INCONSISTENT`, `READ_ONLY_WORKSPACE`, `IMPLEMENTATION_STATE`, `INVALID_TRANSITION`, archive codes). Never drop requires/approval failures even if hop omitted. Same evaluation as statuses/transitions.
- Check blockers: `label` (gerund), SHOULD `checkId`, `code`, `message`; review-only may omit `label`. `isSkippable` + `bypassFlag: '--skip-checks <checkId>'` only when resolved binding skippable (schema-declared included). `IMPLEMENTATION_STATE`: only `impl.linksInScope` skippable, not `impl.filesResolved`.
- `review.required` true -> human `message` (overlap: explain conflict with archived overlapping specs); `nextAction.reason` SHOULD use it. Drifted/pending non-task artifacts -> `review.required=true`; route current lifecycle skill under `workflow: preserve` unless required stale spec consent/redesign needs `designing`; `workflow: redesign` -> `designing`.
- Validity projection exposes independently: artifact/workflow policies, non-task drift/pending review, spec-approval/sign-off (absent/`valid`/`stale`/`revoked`), verification (never/legacy unknown/`valid`/`stale`) separate from active attempt identity/baseline/freshness, fingerprint changed/missing/added/removed/renamed/unlinked + causes, automatic return committed this request, canonical blockers/nextAction. Keep active-attempt and completed evidence simultaneously.
- `fingerprintIssues`: unreadable/missing/unsafe inputs, non-blocking diagnostic; no synthesized blockers.
- Recovery: stale required spec consent -> `designing`; stale sign-off alone returns to `done`, stale verification then recommends verify before sign-off. Stale verification in `designing`/`ready`/`implementing` is context only. At verification boundaries missing/stale evidence -> run verification skill in current state; mismatched attempt -> explicit start + repeat checks, no forced exit/re-entry. Never call `CompleteVerification` or treat attempt as evidence. `preserve` ungated: review stays in state, unresolved drift/review blocks forward; structural validation alone does not renew approval/verification.
- Deps: change repo, schema provider, approval-gate config, `RefreshImplementationTracking`, central reconciler (required; absence fails explicitly, no legacy fallback), composed transition/archive checks, optional `CheckRegistry`. Imports `evaluateLifecycle` as module function; no lifecycle engine injection. No fs adapters, no second invalidation path.
- `createGetStatus(config, options?)` derives deps via `resolveGetStatusDeps(resolver)` then delegates to `createGetStatus(deps)`; keeps complete repository bootstrap (schema-driven artifact types), no weaker repo variant, no inline fs wiring. Resolves `changes`, `schemaProvider`, `approvals` `{ spec, signoff }`, `refreshImplementationTracking`, composed checks from `create*`, `transitionBindings`, `archiveBindings`, `checkRegistry` (all from `resolveWorkflowCheckRegistry`). Never resolves `lifecycle`/`LifecycleEngine`/`evaluateLifecycle`.

## Constraints
- Active status may persist only reconciler-selected validity effects; never independently mutate approval/verification/artifact/lifecycle. Draft/archived/schema-unavailable read-only.
- Artifact + impl contents may be read for fresh validity facts; otherwise no full content load except in matching check. Reuse `workflow.taskCompletion` counts; no second `CountTasks`.
- Dependency-aware presentation delegated to `evaluateLifecycle`/`projectArtifacts`, not `Change`.
- `changePath` from `ChangeRepository.changePath(change)`.
